how: the closed form of the shifted-lattice Kronecker limit is, term by term, the function main's own frame uses (B1940's frame_mp.F_u, 'B1919's closed form', read in its source): for a non-integer first shift, -pi (log y + 2 log 2 + psi(a) + psi(1 - a)) plus the sum over rows of (2 pi/|m|) Re(q/(1 - q)); for an integer first shift, pi (2 gamma - 2 log 2 - log y) plus the zero-row term pi^2 y/sin^2(pi b). So the lane's formula and main's are one
note: The lane's own check ('computed once' against the Hurwitz-Bessel definition at fifty digits) is its own; main's B1919 and B1924 carry the same form with their own checks.
